posts.author: preserve_founder
posts.content: Preserve Archive 001. Numbered 001-100. A hand-painted tin, a T-shirt and one marigold seed for Rs 1,099. Preorder only, link in bio, ships 3-4 weeks after you pay.

posts.author: archetype_drop_culture_collector_lead
posts.content: New numbered drop from a brand nobody has heard of: tin, tee, marigold seed, Rs 1,099, all preorder. The 001-100 numbering I like. Paying up front with no fabric, no sizes and no refund info, I do not. Who is behind this?

posts.author: preserve_founder
posts.content: The link stays live while numbers remain. I have read every question about fabric, sizes, the tin and how to grow the seed, and I will answer them properly in one post rather than piecemeal.

posts.author: archetype_gift_buyer_lead
posts.content: Gift check: I love the plant-to-grow idea, but there is nothing to see yet and the wait is 3-4 weeks. If you have preordered as a gift, how are you handling the what-if-it-is-late part?

posts.author: archetype_skeptical_scroller
posts.content: Quick maths: 100 units x Rs 1,099 is Rs 1,09,900 sitting with someone with no face, no history and no refund policy, for a product that does not exist. Call it faith if you like.

posts.author: preserve_founder
posts.content: Archive 001 is in the making. I will not post unfinished photos. The first thing you see of the tin will be the real tin.

posts.author: preserve_founder
posts.content: To the rumour that Preserve resells blanks: I made every decision on Archive 001 myself. You will see it when it ships. That is my answer.

posts.author: archetype_drop_culture_collector_lead
posts.content: Decision time: I am in for a number. The founder dodged the rumour but did not deny the work, and 001-100 on a hand-painted tin is not something I want to watch from outside. Fabric and sizes are still on them, though.

posts.author: archetype_gift_buyer_lead
posts.content: If delivery is tight for the occasion, a gift that arrives late is worse than no gift. I am torn, and I would rather say so than pretend otherwise.

posts.author: preserve_founder
posts.content: Archive 001 starts shipping this week. I will post when the first ones land.

posts.author: archetype_skeptical_scroller
posts.content: Shipping week. This is where we find out whether the preorder crowd got a tin or a story.

posts.author: group_a_collectors_04
posts.content: Mine arrived. Hand-painted tin, brush marks visible, number on it. Tee still in the wrapping; I am checking fabric and fit before I say a word on those.

posts.author: archetype_drop_culture_collector_lead
posts.content: Mine landed. Tin first impressions: genuinely good. Tee review after I have worn it. I will not hype what I have not worn.

posts.author: preserve_founder
posts.content: Thank you for the first unboxings. Now the real test: put the seed in soil and tell me how it goes, good or bad.

posts.author: group_a_collectors_04
posts.content: Day five and the marigold is up. Pictures on my stories.

posts.author: group_a_collectors_02
posts.content: Planted the seed on day two. Nothing so far. Is it only me?

posts.author: group_b_gift_buyers_03
posts.content: My cousin's marigold died within a week. No care instructions anywhere.

posts.author: preserve_founder
posts.content: Germination varies. I do not have a number to give you yet. If your seed did not sprout, message me.

posts.author: archetype_skeptical_scroller
posts.content: Credit where due: it arrived, the tin is real, and the founder finally gave a straight answer. I am still not prepaying for Archive 002 blind. Show me blooms first.

posts.author: preserve_founder
posts.content: People are asking about Archive 002. It comes after Archive 001 has settled, and I will announce it when it is ready. The product and the price are not decided.

posts.author: archetype_drop_culture_collector_lead
posts.content: Tee worn, tin on the desk, seed finally up. The brand has done what it said it would. What it never said is still open.

posts.author: archetype_gift_buyer_lead
posts.content: The marigold I gave did not come up. The tin is lovely, and that makes the distance between lovely and useful feel larger.

posts.author: group_a_collectors_04
posts.content: First bloom. Orange, fully open, completely real. Photo on my stories and here.

posts.author: group_a_collectors_01
posts.content: Mine opened this morning. Number on the tin, flower on the shelf. That is what I paid for.

posts.author: group_a_collectors_02
posts.content: Dead-seed count on this page so far: me, Dev, two gift buyers and the gift lead. Nobody in charge has said sorry or said what happens next.

posts.author: preserve_founder
posts.content: To everyone whose seed did not come up: I have heard you. I do not have a germination figure and I will not invent one. Message me and I will reply to each of you.

posts.author: preserve_founder
posts.content: Archive 002 will be announced in two days. Not before.

posts.author: preserve_founder
posts.content: Archive 002 is announced. The product and the price come with the link, not before. I have heard the questions about growing, sizes and refunds, and I will answer what I can when the link opens and say plainly what I cannot.

posts.author: archetype_drop_culture_collector_lead
posts.content: Mine bloomed. Tin, number and now the flower: the brand did what it said every time. On Archive 002 I lean in, but I want the product and the price first, and I still will not review a tee whose fabric and sizes nobody has stated.

posts.author: preserve_founder
posts.content: Archive 001 is out in the world. Some of it bloomed and some of it did not. I will tell you what I know and what I do not. The link for Archive 002 opens when I can stand behind it.
